$comment: Hand-edited source of truth for the Siena clone IA. Derived from src/routes.js, src/App.jsx and the imports/JSX of src/pages/*.jsx (ground truth), with section naming and order cross-checked against CLONE_SPEC.md and specs/*.md. implementedBy paths are relative to src/components/ unless they start with pages/ (relative to src/). Section order is desktop DOM order; /qa-agent and /topics-explorer reorder some sections on phone via CSS order (styles/product-a.css). Decorative layers (EdgeFades, cv-fade strips, AI Lab pixel tiles, the add-ons phone-only empty spacer) are not modelled as sections. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs; do not edit them.

meta.mirror: https://www.siena.cx/ (originally Framer), rebuilt in React 18 + Vite + Tailwind v3 + react-router-dom v6 at /Users/riyaghosh/V3/siena
meta.scopeNote: Only the 35 locally cloned routes are counted: '/' plus the 34 entries of ROUTES in src/routes.js. The live sitemap lists 171 URLs; the remaining collections (51 /blog, 37 /customer-stories, 29 /integrations, 11 /product-updates, 7 /webinar + /webinars) are deliberately not cloned and every link to them resolves to live siena.cx through siteHref() in src/routes.js.
meta.chromeAxis: full = site Nav + Footer (Nav.jsx starts transparent, turns solid on scroll); full-solid-nav = same but NAV_OVERRIDES.forceScrolled pins the nav in its scrolled/solid state; full-alt-cta = same but NAV_OVERRIDES swaps the nav CTA to 'See open roles'; own-nav = NAV_OVERRIDES.hideNav, page renders its own dark nav, site Footer kept; none = NAV_OVERRIDES.hideChrome, no site Nav or Footer, page renders its own logo header + legal row.
meta.generatedBy: ia-builder skill (hand-written ia.json; build.mjs/validate.mjs copied unchanged)

categories.CHROME: Page frame outside the content flow: the site nav and footer from App.jsx's Chrome wrapper, and the per-page replacements for them.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block (H1, sub copy, primary CTA, and any visual or form that shares the first viewport).
categories.PROOF: Social proof: logo tickers and grids, testimonial sliders, metrics, customer stories, walls of love.
categories.PRODUCT: Explanations of what a Siena product does: scroll areas, feature rows, bentos, how-it-works blocks, product mockups.
categories.STACK: How Siena fits a brand's existing tools and risk requirements: integrations grids and enterprise-grade safety blocks.
categories.EVALUATE: Buyer-evaluation blocks: pricing explanation, competitor comparison tables, before-vs-with-Siena lists.
categories.COMPANY: Company, culture and programme narrative: mission story, team, careers, partner and referral programmes, AI Lab sessions.
categories.CONTENT: Editorial or CMS-style body content: article bodies, legal text, index grids, event and story lists.
categories.CONVERT: Conversion endings and capture: closing CTAs, demo/newsletter forms, application modals.

chrome.site-nav.description: Global announcement bar + floating nav pill with Product/Resources/Partners/Company mega-menus and a Book a demo CTA (mobile: full-width bar + drawer). Per-route behaviour (CTA swap, forced scrolled state) comes from NAV_OVERRIDES, not separate components.
chrome.site-nav.scope: Rendered by App.jsx's Chrome wrapper on 32 routes: every route except /ai-lab, /pricing and /book-a-demo.

chrome.site-footer.description: Global footer: link columns, SOC badge, socials and the large Siena wordmark.
chrome.site-footer.scope: Rendered by App.jsx's Chrome wrapper on 33 routes: every route except the two hideChrome lead-form pages.

chrome.ai-lab-nav.description: Dark AI Lab-only nav (Siena logo, in-page anchors, event CTA) that replaces the site nav on the AI Lab page; the page's decorative pixel tiles sit behind it.
chrome.ai-lab-nav.scope: Only the AI Lab page (NAV_OVERRIDES hideNav).

chrome.lead-header.description: Minimal non-fixed header with just the Siena wordmark, replacing the site nav on the lead-form pages.
chrome.lead-header.scope: The pricing and book-a-demo pages (NAV_OVERRIDES hideChrome).

chrome.legal-row.description: Single-row page footer with copyright and legal links, replacing the site footer on the lead-form pages.
chrome.legal-row.scope: The pricing and book-a-demo pages (NAV_OVERRIDES hideChrome).
